metrics.units_note: Gamma_max trained with internal y_scale=1e6. metrics.json/_runs_index record test_rmse & test_mae as 0.0 because ROUNDED TO 4 DECIMALS IN RAW units (mol/m2, ~1e-6 -> 0.0000) — a rounding artifact, NOT a perfect fit. Independent recomputation from the saved model on the cached 70-sample test set yields raw test RMSE=1.4157e-6 mol/m2, MAE=1.0487e-6 mol/m2, R2=-0.01 (exact match). best_val_rmse=2.13 is in SCALED units (x1e6) == ~2.1e-6 mol/m2 raw; early stopping at epoch 530 (best val epoch ~300). R2=-0.01 is genuine and unitless; the model collapsed to an essentially constant prediction (~2.334e-6 mol/m2, std~8e-11), explaining nothing beyond the mean baseline. The paper table should cite R2 = -0.01, and RMSE ~1.4e-6 mol/m2 (or ~2.3 in scaled units) with a footnote that the recorded 0.0 is the 4-dp rounding of raw values.
